description: Capital purchase of computer equipment (capital allowances, not revenue expense)
notes: Under TCA 1997 s.284, computer equipment qualifies for capital allowances (writing down allowances). Capital purchases are not treated as revenue expenses — they go to a fixed-asset account. The capital_allowances topic exists in the KB. Review required because rules carry reviewStatus 'ai_extracted'.
